name: Outdoor Room, Houston
line: Warm All Year, Even In Texas
lede: In Houston’s Memorial area, a patio builder created an outdoor living space of about 550 sq ft, with an outdoor kitchen and Bromic heaters so it stays comfortable all year.

beats: An outdoor living area of about 550 sq ft with an outdoor kitchen, built by Texas Custom Patios.
In a warm-climate market, the outdoor room still had to be usable on the few cold evenings – all year round.
Bromic heaters were installed for year-round comfort. The project page has since been taken down; the details come from its search listing.
